hook: Jubilee Hills enters Asia's priciest streets at *₹250*/sq ft
hook_b: Jubilee Hills enters Asia's priciest streets at *₹250*/sq ft
tldr: Cushman & Wakefield's Main Streets Across the World 2026 lists three Hyderabad high streets in Asia-Pacific: Jubilee Hills (51st, new entry), Banjara Hills and Himayatnagar (joint 52nd).

beats.what: Prime retail rents: Jubilee Hills ₹250, Banjara Hills ₹230, Himayatnagar ₹225 per sq ft per month.
beats.why: Only Banjara Hills and Himayatnagar made the previous edition; Jubilee Hills joined this year.
beats.care: High rents on these streets feed into what shops and cafes there charge.

facts.t: Delhi's Khan Market ranks *24th* globally, India's priciest high street.
